#!/bin/sh
. /lib/functions.sh
. /lib/functions/system.sh
. /usr/exe/varset.sh

# initialize defaults
RAMFS_COPY_BIN=""	# extra programs for temporary ramfs root
RAMFS_COPY_DATA=""	# extra data files
export MTD_CONFIG_ARGS=""
export INTERACTIVE=0
export VERBOSE=1
export SAVE_CONFIG=1
export SAVE_OVERLAY=0
export DELAY=
export CONF_IMAGE=
export CONF_BACKUP_LIST=0
export CONF_BACKUP=
export CONF_RESTORE=
export NEED_IMAGE=
export HELP=0
export FORCE=0
export TEST=0

# parse options
while [ -n "$1" ]; do
	case "$1" in
		-i) export INTERACTIVE=1;;
		-d) export DELAY="$2"; shift;;
		-v) export VERBOSE="$(($VERBOSE + 1))";;
		-q) export VERBOSE="$(($VERBOSE - 1))";;
		-n) export SAVE_CONFIG=0;;
		-c) export SAVE_OVERLAY=1;;
		-b|--create-backup) export CONF_BACKUP="$2" NEED_IMAGE=1; shift;;
		-r|--restore-backup) export CONF_RESTORE="$2" NEED_IMAGE=1; shift;;
		-l|--list-backup) export CONF_BACKUP_LIST=1; break;;
		-f) export CONF_IMAGE="$2"; shift;;
		-F|--force) export FORCE=1;;
		-T|--test) export TEST=1;;
		-h|--help) export HELP=1; break;;
		-*)
			echo "Invalid option: $1"
			exit 1
		;;
		*) break;;
	esac
	shift;
done

export CONFFILES=/tmp/sysupgrade.conffiles
export CONF_TAR=/tmp/sysupgrade.tgz

export ARGV="$*"
export ARGC="$#"

[ -z "$ARGV" -a -z "$NEED_IMAGE" -o $HELP -gt 0 ] && {
	cat <<EOF
Usage: $0 [<upgrade-option>...] <image file or URL>
       $0 [-q] [-i] <backup-command> <file>

upgrade-option:
	-d <delay>   add a delay before rebooting
	-f <config>  restore configuration from .tar.gz (file or url)
	-i           interactive mode
	-c           attempt to preserve all changed files in /etc/
	-n           do not save configuration over reflash
	-T | --test
	             Verify image and config .tar.gz but do not actually flash.
	-F | --force
	             Flash image even if image checks fail, this is dangerous!
	-q           less verbose
	-v           more verbose
	-h | --help  display this help

backup-command:
	-b | --create-backup <file>
	             create .tar.gz of files specified in sysupgrade.conf
	             then exit. Does not flash an image. If file is '-',
	             i.e. stdout, verbosity is set to 0 (i.e. quiet).
	-r | --restore-backup <file>
	             restore a .tar.gz created with sysupgrade -b
	             then exit. Does not flash an image. If file is '-',
	             the archive is read from stdin.
	-l | --list-backup
	             list the files that would be backed up when calling
	             sysupgrade -b. Does not create a backup file.

EOF
	exit 1
}

[ -n "$ARGV" -a -n "$NEED_IMAGE" ] && {
	cat <<-EOF
		-b|--create-backup and -r|--restore-backup do not perform a firmware upgrade.
		Do not specify both -b|-r and a firmware image.
	EOF
	exit 1
}

# prevent messages from clobbering the tarball when using stdout
[ "$CONF_BACKUP" = "-" ] && export VERBOSE=0

delete_unsaved_uci_conffiles()
{
       for file in $(/usr/exe/json_paser SWUpgradeParams.UpgradeUNSaveFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
       do
               echo "remove file: $file from keep file list" >> $UPGRADELOG
               sed -i 's#'^$file'#EXCLUSIVE#;/EXCLUSIVE/d' $CONFFILES
       done
}

add_save_file_list()
{
    for file in $(/usr/exe/json_paser SWUpgradeParams.UpgradeSaveFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
    do
        echo "add file: $file to keep file list" >> $UPGRADELOG
        echo "$file"  >> $CONFFILES
    done
}


add_uci_conffiles() {
	local file="$1"
	( find $(sed -ne '/^[[:space:]]*$/d; /^#/d; p' \
		/etc/sysupgrade.conf /lib/upgrade/keep.d/* 2>/dev/null) \
		-type f -o -type l 2>/dev/null;
	  opkg list-changed-conffiles ) | sort -u > "$file"
	return 0
}

add_overlayfiles() {
	local file="$1"
	if [ -d /overlay/upper ]; then
		local overlaydir="/overlay/upper"
	else
		local overlaydir="/overlay"
	fi
	find $overlaydir/etc/ -type f -o -type l | sed \
		-e 's,^/overlay/,/,' \
		-e '\,/META_[a-zA-Z0-9]*$,d' \
		-e '\,/functions.sh$,d' \
		-e '\,/[^/]*-opkg$,d' \
	> "$file"
	return 0
}

# hooks
sysupgrade_image_check="platform_check_image"
[ $SAVE_OVERLAY = 0 -o ! -d /overlay/etc ] && \

	/usr/sbin/imageTool -t $tag -i $image -w /dev/$mtdpart &>/dev/null

do_flash_failsafe_partition() {
	local tag=$1
	local image=$2
	local mtdname=$3

	# Fail safe upgrade
	primaryboot=$(get_boot_index)
	if [ $primaryboot -eq 0 ]; then

	echo -e "\n\nSoftware upgrade start @ $(date) ..." |tee -a $UPGRADELOG
	/usr/sbin/imageTool -t imginfo -i $1 -o $IMGUPGINFO &>/dev/null
	if [ $? != 0 ]; then 
		echo "Software image $1 parsing failed!" |tee -a $UPGRADELOG
		rm -rf $1 &>/dev/null
		return 1
	fi

	curImgVersion=$(cat /etc/buildinfo | grep -w IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
	curSWVersion=$(cat /etc/buildinfo | grep -w SOFTWAREVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
	upgImgVersion=$(grep -w IMAGEVERSION $IMGUPGINFO | cut -d'=' -f2)
	upgSWVersion=$(grep -w SOFTWAREVERSION $IMGUPGINFO | cut -d'=' -f2)
	partnumber=$(/usr/sbin/ritool get PartNumber |cut -d: -f2 |sed 's/^[ \t]//g '|cut -c-10)
	grep $partnumber $IMGUPGINFO &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
		echo "Checking image ..." |tee -a $UPGRADELOG
		echo "Software upgrade from $curImgVersion($curSWVersion) to $upgImgVersion($upgSWVersion) ..." |tee -a $UPGRADELOG
		return 0
	else
		echo "Software image NOT match HW version, upgrade forbidden!" |tee -a $UPGRADELOG
		rm -rf $1
		return 1
	fi
}

set_img_ver() {

	# update version after burning image
	curImgVersion=$(cat /etc/buildinfo | grep -w IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
	newImgVersion=$(grep -w IMAGEVERSION $IMGUPGINFO | cut -d'=' -f2)

	current=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n active_part)
	standby=$((1-$current))

	/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$current $curImgVersion &>/dev/null
	/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$standby $newImgVersion &>/dev/null

	# set valid bit
	sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	if [ $standby -eq 0 ]; then
		let "sb_data=sb_num | 0x02"
	else
		let "sb_data=sb_num | 0x20"
	fi
	/usr/sbin/fw_setenv sb_flag $sb_data
}

clear_img_ver() {

	# set imageversion null brfore burning
	newImgVersion="null"
	current=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n active_part)
	standby=$((1-$current))
	/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$standby $newImgVersion &>/dev/null

	# clear valid bit
	sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	if [ $standby -eq 0 ]; then
		let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xFD"
	else
		let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xDF"
	fi
	/usr/sbin/fw_setenv sb_flag $sb_data
}

platform_do_upgrade() {
	for tag_list in $(/usr/exe/json_paser PackImageParas.SubImageInfo < /etc/HB_Config.json)
	do
		tag=$(echo $tag_list | cut -d: -f1)
		case "${tag}" in

			rootfs) do_flash_mtd $tag $1 "rootfs$((1-$(get_boot_index)))" ;;

#!/bin/sh

RAM_ROOT=/tmp/root

[ -x /usr/bin/ldd ] || ldd() { LD_TRACE_LOADED_OBJECTS=1 $*; }
libs() { ldd $* 2>/dev/null | sed -r 's/(.* => )?(.*) .*/\2/'; }

install_file() { # <file> [ <file> ... ]
	for file in "$@"; do
		dest="$RAM_ROOT/$file"
		[ -f $file -a ! -f $dest ] && {
			dir="$(dirname $dest)"
			mkdir -p "$dir"
			cp $file $dest
		}
	done
}

install_bin() { # <file> [ <symlink> ... ]
	src=$1
	files=$1
	[ -x "$src" ] && files="$src $(libs $src)"
	install_file $files
	shift
	for link in "$@"; do {
		dest="$RAM_ROOT/$link"
		dir="$(dirname $dest)"
		mkdir -p "$dir"
		[ -f "$dest" ] || ln -s $src $dest
	}; done
}

supivot() { # <new_root> <old_root>
	/bin/mount | grep "on $1 type" 2>&- 1>&- || /bin/mount -o bind $1 $1
	mkdir -p $1$2 $1/proc $1/sys $1/dev $1/tmp $1/overlay && \
	/bin/mount -o noatime,move /proc $1/proc && \
	pivot_root $1 $1$2 || {
		/bin/umount -l $1 $1
		return 1
	}

	/bin/mount -o noatime,move $2/sys /sys
	/bin/mount -o noatime,move $2/dev /dev
	/bin/mount -o noatime,move $2/tmp /tmp
	/bin/mount -o noatime,move $2/overlay /overlay 2>&-
	return 0
}

run_ramfs() { # <command> [...]
	install_bin /bin/busybox /bin/ash /bin/sh /bin/mount /bin/umount	\
		/sbin/pivot_root /usr/bin/wget /sbin/reboot /bin/sync /bin/dd	\
		/bin/grep /bin/cp /bin/mv /bin/tar /usr/bin/md5sum "/usr/bin/["	\
		/bin/dd /bin/vi /bin/ls /bin/cat /usr/bin/awk /usr/bin/hexdump	\
		/bin/sleep /bin/zcat /usr/bin/bzcat /usr/bin/printf /usr/bin/wc \
		/bin/cut /usr/bin/printf /bin/sync /bin/mkdir /bin/rmdir	\
		/bin/rm /usr/bin/basename /bin/kill /bin/chmod /bin/sed

	install_bin /sbin/mtd
	install_bin /sbin/mount_root
	install_bin /sbin/snapshot
	install_bin /sbin/snapshot_tool
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubiupdatevol
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubiattach
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubiblock
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubiformat
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubidetach
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubirsvol
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubirmvol
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubimkvol
	for file in $RAMFS_COPY_BIN; do
		install_bin ${file//:/ }
	done
	install_file /etc/resolv.conf /lib/*.sh /lib/functions/*.sh /lib/upgrade/*.sh $RAMFS_COPY_DATA

	[ -L "/lib64" ] && ln -s /lib $RAM_ROOT/lib64

	supivot $RAM_ROOT /mnt || {
		echo "Failed to switch over to ramfs. Please reboot."
		exit 1
	}

	/bin/mount -o remount,ro /mnt
	/bin/umount -l /mnt

	grep /overlay /proc/mounts > /dev/null && {
		/bin/mount -o noatime,remount,ro /overlay
		/bin/umount -l /overlay
	}

	# spawn a new shell from ramdisk to reduce the probability of cache issues
	exec /bin/busybox ash -c "$*"
}

kill_remaining() { # [ <signal> ]
	local sig="${1:-TERM}"
	echo -n "Sending $sig to remaining processes ... "

	local my_pid=$$
	local my_ppid=$(cut -d' ' -f4  /proc/$my_pid/stat)
	local my_ppisupgraded=
	grep -q upgraded /proc/$my_ppid/cmdline >/dev/null && {
		local my_ppisupgraded=1
	}
	
	local stat
	for stat in /proc/[0-9]*/stat; do
		[ -f "$stat" ] || continue

		local pid name state ppid rest
		read pid name state ppid rest < $stat
		name="${name#(}"; name="${name%)}"

		local cmdline
		read cmdline < /proc/$pid/cmdline

		# Skip kernel threads
		[ -n "$cmdline" ] || continue

		if [ $$ -eq 1 ] || [ $my_ppid -eq 1 ] && [ -n "$my_ppisupgraded" ]; then
			# Running as init process, kill everything except me
			if [ $pid -ne $$ ] && [ $pid -ne $my_ppid ]; then
				echo -n "$name "
				kill -$sig $pid 2>/dev/null
			fi
		else 
			case "$name" in
				# Skip essential services
				*upgraded*|*procd*|*ash*|*init*|*watchdog*|*ssh*|*dropbear*|*telnet*|*login*|*hostapd*|*wpa_supplicant*|*nas*) : ;;

				# Killable process
				*)
					if [ $pid -ne $$ ] && [ $ppid -ne $$ ]; then
						echo -n "$name "
						kill -$sig $pid 2>/dev/null
					fi
				;;
			esac
		fi
	done
	echo ""
}

run_hooks() {
	local arg="$1"; shift
	for func in "$@"; do
		eval "$func $arg"
	done
}

ask_bool() {
	local default="$1"; shift;
	local answer="$default"

	[ "$INTERACTIVE" -eq 1 ] && {
		case "$default" in
			0) echo -n "$* (y/N): ";;
			*) echo -n "$* (Y/n): ";;
		esac
		read answer
		case "$answer" in
			y*) answer=1;;
			n*) answer=0;;
			*) answer="$default";;
		esac
	}
	[ "$answer" -gt 0 ]
}

v() {
	[ "$VERBOSE" -ge 1 ] && echo "$@"
}

rootfs_type() {
	/bin/mount | awk '($3 ~ /^\/$/) && ($5 !~ /rootfs/) { print $5 }'
}

get_image() { # <source> [ <command> ]
	local from="$1"
	local conc="$2"
	local cmd

	case "$from" in
		http://*|ftp://*) cmd="wget -O- -q";;
		*) cmd="cat";;
	esac
	if [ -z "$conc" ]; then
		local magic="$(eval $cmd \"$from\" 2>/dev/null | dd bs=2 count=1 2>/dev/null | hexdump -n 2 -e '1/1 "%02x"')"
		case "$magic" in
			1f8b) conc="zcat";;
			425a) conc="bzcat";;
		esac
	fi

	eval "$cmd \"$from\" 2>/dev/null ${conc:+| $conc}"
}

get_magic_word() {
	(get_image "$@" | dd bs=2 count=1 | hexdump -v -n 2 -e '1/1 "%02x"') 2>/dev/null
}

get_magic_long() {
	(get_image "$@" | dd bs=4 count=1 | hexdump -v -n 4 -e '1/1 "%02x"') 2>/dev/null
}

jffs2_copy_config() {
	if grep rootfs_data /proc/mtd >/dev/null; then
		# squashfs+jffs2
		mtd -e rootfs_data jffs2write "$CONF_TAR" rootfs_data &>/dev/null
	else
		# jffs2
		mtd jffs2write "$CONF_TAR" rootfs &>/dev/null
	fi
}

# Flash firmware to MTD partition
#
# $(1): path to image
# $(2): (optional) pipe command to extract firmware, e.g. dd bs=n skip=m
default_do_upgrade() {
	sync
	if [ "$SAVE_CONFIG" -eq 1 ]; then
		get_image "$1" "$2" | mtd $MTD_CONFIG_ARGS -j "$CONF_TAR" write - "${PART_NAME:-image}" &>/dev/null
	else
		get_image "$1" "$2" | mtd write - "${PART_NAME:-image}" &>/dev/null
	fi
}

do_upgrade() {
	echo "Performing system upgrade..." | tee -a $UPGRADELOG

	# clear image version
	clear_img_ver &>/dev/null

	if type 'platform_do_upgrade' >/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
		echo "Flsh partitions start..." >> $UPGRADELOG
		platform_do_upgrade "$ARGV"
		echo "Flsh partitions end..." >> $UPGRADELOG
	else
		default_do_upgrade "$ARGV"
	fi

    
	if [ "$SAVE_CONFIG" -eq 1 ] && type 'platform_copy_config' >/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
		echo "Copy config start..." >> $UPGRADELOG
		platform_copy_config
		echo "Copy config end..." >> $UPGRADELOG
	fi

	# set image version
	set_img_ver &>/dev/null

	echo "Upgrade completed" | tee -a $UPGRADELOG

	return 0

	[ -n "$DELAY" ] && sleep "$DELAY"
	ask_bool 1 "Reboot" && {
		v "Rebooting system..."
		sleep 2
		reboot -f
		sleep 5
		echo b 2>/dev/null >/proc/sysrq-trigger
	}
}

#!/bin/sh /etc/rc.common

START=11
STOP=99

. /usr/exe/varset.sh

load_EXTFS_allocate_handler() {
	if [ -e /lib/modules/4.14.180/extfs_drv.ko ]; then
		#allocate SECURITY offset at 5th block, BOSA_OFFSET at 6th block
		ERASE_SIZE=$(cat /proc/mtd | grep extfs | cut -d " " -f3)
		if [ "$ERASE_SIZE" = "00040000" ]; then
			SECURITY_OFFSET=1048576     #1048576 ==> 4*256*1024, 256K/block for g2426ga flash
			BOSA_OFFSET=1310720         #1310720 ==> 5*256*1024, 256K/block for g2426ga flash
		else
			SECURITY_OFFSET=524288      #524288 ==> 4*128*1024, 128K/block for other mtk flash
			BOSA_OFFSET=655360          #655360 ==> 5*128*1024, 128K/block for other mtk flash
		fi
		/usr/sbin/extfstool newitem SECURITY $SECURITY_OFFSET
		/usr/sbin/extfstool newitem BOSA $BOSA_OFFSET
	fi
}

TX_DIS=3
TX_PWR=8
optics_shut()
{
	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: disable TX_DIS:$TX_DIS ..." |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        echo $TX_DIS > /sys/class/gpio/export
        echo "out" > /sys/class/gpio/gpio$TX_DIS/direction
        echo 1 > /sys/class/gpio/gpio$TX_DIS/value
#       echo $TX_DIS > /sys/class/gpio/unexport
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: disable TX_PWR:$TX_PWR ..." |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        echo $TX_PWR > /sys/class/gpio/export
        echo "out" > /sys/class/gpio/gpio$TX_PWR/direction
        echo 1 > /sys/class/gpio/gpio$TX_PWR/value
#       echo $TX_PWR > /sys/class/gpio/unexport
}

bosadev_init()
{
	optics_shut
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: enable TX_PWR:$TX_PWR delay 3s ..." |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        echo 0 > /sys/class/gpio/gpio$TX_PWR/value
	mkdir -p /configs/bosa/
        sleep 3
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: load bosa driver ..." |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        insmod bosa.ko
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: disable TX_PWR:$TX_PWR ..." |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        echo 1 > /sys/class/gpio/gpio$TX_DIS/value
        dev_name="/dev/bosa"
        major=`cat /proc/devices | grep bosa | awk '{print $1}'`
        minor=0
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mknod for /dev/bosa ..." |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        mknod $dev_name c $major $minor
	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: bosa init completed!" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
}

ethernet_init()
{
    mac0=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f2 | cut -d" " -f2)
    newMac0=$(( (0x${mac0} + 6) % 256 ))

    enetNum=$(hcfgtool get ENET.NUMS)
    for i in $(seq 1 $enetNum)
    do
        mac1=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f3)
        mac2=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f4)
        mac3=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f5)
        mac4=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f6)
        mac5=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f7)

        newMac5=$(( (0x${mac5} + $i) % 256 ))
        carry=$(( (0x${mac5} + $i) / 256 ))

        newMac4=$(( (0x${mac4} + $carry) % 256 ))
        carry=$(( (0x${mac4} + $carry) / 256 ))

        newMac3=$(( (0x${mac3} + $carry) % 256 ))
        carry=$(( (0x${mac3} + $carry) / 256 ))

        newMac2=$(( (0x${mac2} + $carry) % 256 ))
        carry=$(( (0x${mac2} + $carry) / 256 ))

        newMac1=$(( (0x${mac1} + $carry) % 256 ))
        carry=$(( (0x${mac1} + $carry) / 256 ))

        if [ $carry != 0 ]; then
            logger "New mac error basing on MAC:$(ritool get MACAddress)"
        fi

        index=$(($i - 1))
        newMac=$(printf "%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X" $newMac0 $newMac1 $newMac2 $newMac3 $newMac4 $newMac5)
        ifconfig eth$index down
        ifconfig eth$index hw ether $newMac
        ifconfig eth$index up
    done
}

        ethernet_init
	uci set network.lan.type='bridge'
	uci del network.lan.ifname

	uci add_list network.lan.ifname='ecd0'

	uci set network.lan.macaddr=`ritool get MACAddress | cut -d" " -f2`

#	/usr/sbin/batch_upgrade -d
}

phy_crtl_init()
{
	echo "MSG: set phy led register" > /dev/console 2>&1

	# led0 polar register
	POLAR_ADD=0x1fd044
	POLAR_SET=0xFFFE
	polar_data=$(phytool rr 4 $POLAR_ADD | cut -d: -f4)
	let "polar_val=polar_data & POLAR_SET"
	/usr/sbin/phytool rw 4 $POLAR_ADD $polar_val &>/dev/null

	# led0 register
	PHY0_ADD=0x1fd032
	PHY0_SET=0x27
	phy0_reg=$(phytool rr 4 $PHY0_ADD | cut -d: -f4)
	let "phy0_val=phy0_reg | PHY0_SET"
	/usr/sbin/phytool rw 4 $PHY0_ADD $phy0_val &>/dev/null

	# led1 register
	PHY1_ADD=0x1fd034
	PHY1_SET=0x24
	/usr/sbin/phytool rw 4 $PHY1_ADD $PHY1_SET &>/dev/null

	# led2 register
	PHY2_ADD=0x1fd036
	PHY2_SET=0x03
	/usr/sbin/phytool rw 4 $PHY2_ADD $PHY2_SET &>/dev/null

	# led blink/on mode register
	PHY_MOD=0x1fd040
	PHY_MOD_SET=0xFFD9
	phy_mod=$(phytool rr 4 $PHY_MOD | cut -d: -f4)
	let "phy_data=phy_mod & PHY_MOD_SET"
	/usr/sbin/phytool rw 4 $PHY_MOD $phy_data &>/dev/null
}

	if [ -e /logs/reboot.log ]; then
		filesize=$(du -c /logs/reboot.log |grep total |awk '{ print $1 }')
		if [ $filesize -gt 450 ]; then
			[ -e /logs/reboot.log.tar.gz ] && rm /logs/reboot.log.tar.gz
			cd /logs; mv -f reboot.log reboot.bak ; tar zcvf reboot.log.tar.gz  reboot.bak; cd -
			rm /logs/reboot.bak

		fi
	fi
	if [ -e /lib/modules/*/kmsg.ko ]; then
		insmod /lib/modules/*/kmsg.ko
	fi

#!/bin/sh
#set -x
# Define a function to check if the interface is in the bridging interface
check_interfaces() {
    # get the bridging interface name
    bridge_interfaces=$(brctl show | awk 'NR > 1 {print $1}')

    #Run "ifconfig - a" to search for all network interface names and filter out interfaces with IP addresses configured, 
    #excluding the lo interface.
    /sbin/ifconfig | awk '
    /^[a-zA-Z0-9]/ {
        iface = $1
    }
    /inet / {
        ip = $2
        if (iface != "lo") {
            print iface, ip
        }
    }' | while read -r iface ip; do
        # check whether if the bridge exist
        if echo "$bridge_interfaces" | grep -qw "$iface"; then
            echo "$iface"
        else
            echo "9999"
        fi
    done > /tmp/binterface
}

# try time counter
attempts=0

# try 3 times
while [ $attempts -lt 3 ]; do
    
    check_interfaces
    sleep 3

    # check if /tmp/binterface content is "9999"
    if [ "$(cat /tmp/binterface)" = "9999" ]; then
        # try time add one
        attempts=$((attempts + 1))
    else
        break
    fi
done

get_boot_index()
{
        sb0=$(($1 & 0x0f))
        sb1=$(($1 >> 4))

        commit=4

        if [ $((sb0 & $commit)) -eq $commit ]; then
                echo 0
                return
        fi

        echo 1
}

show_sb_values()
{
        index=$1

	if [ $index -eq 0 ];then
                value=$(($2 & 0x0f))
        else
                value=$(($2 >> 4))
	fi

	echo -n "sb$1 : "
	echo -n "actve $(($value & 0x1)) "
	echo -n "valid $((($value & 0x2) >> 1)) "
	echo -n "commit $((($value & 0x4) >> 2 )) "
	echo
}


if [ $# -ne 1 ]; then
        echo "Please tell me the upgrade result."
        echo "Successful or Failed or Preupgrade"
        exit 0

boot_result=$1

sb_val=$(fw_printenv -n sb_flag)

echo "boot partition group is ${boot}. standby partition group is ${standby}"

    echo "Nokia active image in /sbin/switch_partition.sh"

    ca.sb -a 0 -v 0 -c 0 sb${standby}

tmpfile="$(mktemp)"
img="$2"

part_name="0:WIFIFW"
status="failed"
ubi_part_name="rootfs"

# if a subdevice is specified, eg. qcn9000
if [ "$#" -eq 3 ]; then
	subdev="$3"
fi

if echo "$device" | grep -q "IPQ807" ; then
	flashfw=/lib/firmware/IPQ8074/WIFI_FW
	emmc_part=$(find_mmc_part $part_name 2> /dev/null)
	nand_part=$(find_mtd_part $part_name 2> /dev/null)
elif  echo "$device" | grep -q "IPQ6018" ; then
	flashfw=/lib/firmware/IPQ6018/WIFI_FW
	nand_part=$(find_mtd_part $ubi_part_name 2> /dev/null)
	if [ -z "$nand_part" ]; then
		emmc_part=$(find_mmc_part $part_name 2> /dev/null)
	else
		part_name=ubi_part_name
	fi
elif  echo "$device" | grep -q "IPQ5018" ; then
	flashfw=/lib/firmware/IPQ5018/WIFI_FW
	wififw_part=$(cat /proc/mtd | grep $part_name)
	mtd_dev=$(echo $wififw_part | awk '{print $1}' | sed 's/:$//')
	nor_flash=`find /sys/bus/spi/devices/*/mtd -name ${mtd_dev}`
	nand_part=$(find_mtd_part $ubi_part_name 2> /dev/null)
	if [ -z "$nand_part" ]; then
		emmc_part=$(find_mmc_part $part_name 2> /dev/null)
	else
		part_name=ubi_part_name
	fi
else
	echo "Unrecognized Device...\nCurrently Devices Supported: ipq807x & ipq6018 & ipq5018\n"
	exit 0;
fi

if [ -z "$fwpath" ]; then
	echo "Error:Firmware path is empty\n"
	echo "Usages:Please run as below command:\n"
	echo "wlanfw-upgrade.sh <path_to_fw_files> <fw_type(q6/m3/all)> <sub-device>\n"
	exit 0;
fi

printf " Copying firmware files to $tmpdir..\n"
cp -r $flashfw/* $tmpdir/

if [ "$subdev" == "qcn9000" ]; then
	if [ "$img" == "q6" ]; then
		printf " Copying $subdev Q6 images from $fwpath..\n"
		rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/amss.bin
		cp -r $fwpath/amss.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
	elif [ "$img" == "m3" ]; then
		printf " Copying $subdev M3 images from $fwpath..\n"
		rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/m3.bin
		cp -r $fwpath/m3.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
	else
		printf " Copying $subdev Q6 & M3 images from $fwpath..\n"
		rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/amss.bin
		rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/m3.bin
		cp -r $fwpath/amss.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
		cp -r $fwpath/m3.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
	fi
elif [ "$subdev" == "qcn6122" ]; then
	printf " Copying $subdev M3 images from $fwpath..\n"
	rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/m3_*
	cp -r $fwpath/m3_* $tmpdir/$subdev/
elif [ "$img" == "q6" ]; then
	printf " Copying Q6 fw files from $fwpath..\n"
	rm -rf $tmpdir/q6_*
	cp -r $fwpath/q6_* $tmpdir/
elif [ "$img" == "m3" ]; then
	printf " Copying M3 fw files from $fwpath..\n"
	rm -rf $tmpdir/m3_*
	cp -r $fwpath/m3_* $tmpdir/
else
	printf " Copying Q6 & M3 fw files from $fwpath..\n"
	rm -rf $tmpdir/q6_*
	rm -rf $tmpdir/m3_*
	cp -r $fwpath/q6_* $tmpdir/
	cp -r $fwpath/m3_* $tmpdir/

	subdev="qcn9000"
	if [ -d "$flashfw/$subdev" ]; then
		printf " Copying $subdev Q6 & M3 images from $fwpath..\n"
		if [ -f "$fwpath/amss.bin" ]; then
			rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/amss.bin
			cp -r $fwpath/amss.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
		fi

		if [ -f "$fwpath/m3.bin" ]; then
			rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/m3.bin
			cp -r $fwpath/m3.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
		fi
	fi

	subdev="qcn6122"
	if [[ -d "$flashfw/$subdev" && -d "$tmpdir/$subdev" ]]; then
		printf " Copying $subdev M3 images from $fwpath/$subdev..\n"
		rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/m3_*
		cp -r $fwpath/$subdev/m3_* $tmpdir/$subdev/
	fi
fi

printf " Preparing squashfs image..\n"
mksquashfs4  $tmpdir/  $tmpfile -nopad -noappend -root-owned -comp xz -Xpreset 9 -Xe -Xlc 0 -Xlp 2 -Xpb 2 -Xbcj arm -b 256k -processors 1

if [ -n "$emmc_part" ]; then
	emmc_blk=$( echo $emmc_part | cut -c 6-15)
	emmc_partsize=$( cat /sys/class/block/$emmc_blk/size )

	printf " Unmounting $emmc_part \n"
	umount $emmc_part || true

	printf " Flashing squashfs image on $emmc_part ..\n"
	dd if=/dev/zero of=$emmc_part bs=512 count=$emmc_partsize
	dd if=$tmpfile of=$emmc_part

	printf " Mounting $emmc_part \n"
	/bin/mount -t squashfs $emmc_part $flashfw
	status="completed"
elif [ -n "$nor_flash" ]; then
	printf " Unmounting $$mtd_dev \n"
	umount $flashfw || true
	mtd -e /dev/$mtd_dev write $tmpfile /dev/$mtd_dev
	/bin/mount -t squashfs /dev/${mtd_dev//mtd/mtdblock} $flashfw
	status="completed"
elif [ -n "$nand_part" ]; then
	mtdpart=$(grep "\"$part_name\"" /proc/mtd | awk -F: '{print $1}')

	size=$(ls -s $tmpfile | awk '{print $1 "KiB"}')

	printf " Unmounting $flashfw \n"
	umount $flashfw || true

	if [ "$part_name" == "0:WIFIFW" ]; then
		printf " Flash squashfs image on $nand_part\n"
		ubidetach -f -p /dev/$mtdpart || true
		sync

		printf " Formatting /dev/$mtdpart \n"
		ubiformat /dev/$mtdpart

		printf " Attaching ubi on /dev/$mtdpart \n"
		ubiattach -p /dev/${mtdpart}
		ubimkvol /dev/ubi1 -N wifi_fw -s $size
		ubiupdatevol /dev/ubi1_0 $tmpfile
	else
		printf " Flash squashfs image on wifi_fw vol in rootfs partition\n"
		ubirmvol /dev/ubi0 -N wifi_fw
		ubimkvol /dev/ubi0 -N wifi_fw -s $size
		ubiupdatevol /dev/ubi0_1 $tmpfile
	fi

	ubi_part=$(find_mtd_part wifi_fw 2> /dev/null)

	printf " Mounting $ubi_part\n"
	/bin/mount -t squashfs $ubi_part $flashfw
	status="completed"
else
	printf " Flash Type Not Supported \n"
fi

printf " Cleaning up temp files..\n"
rm -rf  $tmpfile $tmpdir/
printf " wlan fw upgrade $status !\n"

#!/bin/sh
. /lib/functions.sh
. /lib/functions/system.sh
. /usr/exe/varset.sh

# initialize defaults
RAMFS_COPY_BIN=""	# extra programs for temporary ramfs root
RAMFS_COPY_DATA=""	# extra data files
export MTD_CONFIG_ARGS=""
export INTERACTIVE=0
export VERBOSE=1
export SAVE_CONFIG=1
export SAVE_OVERLAY=0
export DELAY=
export CONF_IMAGE=
export CONF_BACKUP_LIST=0
export CONF_BACKUP=
export CONF_RESTORE=
export NEED_IMAGE=
export HELP=0
export FORCE=0
export TEST=0

# parse options
while [ -n "$1" ]; do
	case "$1" in
		-i) export INTERACTIVE=1;;
		-d) export DELAY="$2"; shift;;
		-v) export VERBOSE="$(($VERBOSE + 1))";;
		-q) export VERBOSE="$(($VERBOSE - 1))";;
		-n) export SAVE_CONFIG=0;;
		-c) export SAVE_OVERLAY=1;;
		-b|--create-backup) export CONF_BACKUP="$2" NEED_IMAGE=1; shift;;
		-r|--restore-backup) export CONF_RESTORE="$2" NEED_IMAGE=1; shift;;
		-l|--list-backup) export CONF_BACKUP_LIST=1; break;;
		-f) export CONF_IMAGE="$2"; shift;;
		-F|--force) export FORCE=1;;
		-T|--test) export TEST=1;;
		-h|--help) export HELP=1; break;;
		-*)
			echo "Invalid option: $1"
			exit 1
		;;
		*) break;;
	esac
	shift;
done

export CONFFILES=/tmp/sysupgrade.conffiles
export CONF_TAR=/tmp/sysupgrade.tgz

export ARGV="$*"
export ARGC="$#"

[ -z "$ARGV" -a -z "$NEED_IMAGE" -o $HELP -gt 0 ] && {
	cat <<EOF
Usage: $0 [<upgrade-option>...] <image file or URL>
       $0 [-q] [-i] <backup-command> <file>

upgrade-option:
	-d <delay>   add a delay before rebooting
	-f <config>  restore configuration from .tar.gz (file or url)
	-i           interactive mode
	-c           attempt to preserve all changed files in /etc/
	-n           do not save configuration over reflash
	-T | --test
	             Verify image and config .tar.gz but do not actually flash.
	-F | --force
	             Flash image even if image checks fail, this is dangerous!
	-q           less verbose
	-v           more verbose
	-h | --help  display this help

backup-command:
	-b | --create-backup <file>
	             create .tar.gz of files specified in sysupgrade.conf
	             then exit. Does not flash an image. If file is '-',
	             i.e. stdout, verbosity is set to 0 (i.e. quiet).
	-r | --restore-backup <file>
	             restore a .tar.gz created with sysupgrade -b
	             then exit. Does not flash an image. If file is '-',
	             the archive is read from stdin.
	-l | --list-backup
	             list the files that would be backed up when calling
	             sysupgrade -b. Does not create a backup file.

EOF
	exit 1
}

[ -n "$ARGV" -a -n "$NEED_IMAGE" ] && {
	cat <<-EOF
		-b|--create-backup and -r|--restore-backup do not perform a firmware upgrade.
		Do not specify both -b|-r and a firmware image.
	EOF
	exit 1
}

# prevent messages from clobbering the tarball when using stdout
[ "$CONF_BACKUP" = "-" ] && export VERBOSE=0

delete_unsaved_uci_conffiles()
{
       for file in $(/usr/exe/json_paser SWUpgradeParams.UpgradeUNSaveFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
       do
               echo "remove file: $file from keep file list" >> $UPGRADELOG
               sed -i 's#'^$file'#EXCLUSIVE#;/EXCLUSIVE/d' $CONFFILES
       done
}

add_save_file_list()
{
    for file in $(/usr/exe/json_paser SWUpgradeParams.UpgradeSaveFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
    do
        echo "add file: $file to keep file list" >> $UPGRADELOG
        echo "$file"  >> $CONFFILES
    done
}


add_uci_conffiles() {
	local file="$1"
	( find $(sed -ne '/^[[:space:]]*$/d; /^#/d; p' \
		/etc/sysupgrade.conf /lib/upgrade/keep.d/* 2>/dev/null) \
		-type f -o -type l 2>/dev/null;
	  opkg list-changed-conffiles ) | sort -u > "$file"
	return 0
}

add_overlayfiles() {
	local file="$1"
	if [ -d /overlay/upper ]; then
		local overlaydir="/overlay/upper"
	else
		local overlaydir="/overlay"
	fi
	find $overlaydir/etc/ -type f -o -type l | sed \
		-e 's,^/overlay/,/,' \
		-e '\,/META_[a-zA-Z0-9]*$,d' \
		-e '\,/functions.sh$,d' \
		-e '\,/[^/]*-opkg$,d' \
	> "$file"
	return 0
}

# hooks
sysupgrade_image_check="platform_check_image"
[ $SAVE_OVERLAY = 0 -o ! -d /overlay/etc ] && \
	sysupgrade_init_conffiles="add_uci_conffiles" || \
	sysupgrade_init_conffiles="add_overlayfiles"

include /lib/upgrade

[ "$ARGC" -ge 2 ] && {
	cat /tmp/sysinfo/model | grep "IPQ" && shift && ARGV=$1
}

[ "$1" = "nand" ] && nand_upgrade_stage2 $@

do_save_conffiles() {
	local conf_tar="${1:-$CONF_TAR}"

	[ -z "$(rootfs_type)" ] && {
		echo "Cannot save config while running from ramdisk."
		ask_bool 0 "Abort" && exit
		return 0
	}
	run_hooks "$CONFFILES" $sysupgrade_init_conffiles
	ask_bool 0 "Edit config file list" && vi "$CONFFILES"

	delete_unsaved_uci_conffiles

	add_save_file_list

	echo "Saving config files..." | tee -a $UPGRADELOG
	[ "$VERBOSE" -gt 1 ] && TAR_V="v" || TAR_V=""
	tar c${TAR_V}zf "$conf_tar" -T "$CONFFILES" >> $UPGRADELOG 2>&1

	rm -f "$CONFFILES"
}

if [ $CONF_BACKUP_LIST -eq 1 ]; then
	add_uci_conffiles "$CONFFILES"
	cat "$CONFFILES"
	rm -f "$CONFFILES"
	exit 0
fi

if [ -n "$CONF_BACKUP" ]; then
	do_save_conffiles "$CONF_BACKUP"
	exit $?
fi

if [ -n "$CONF_RESTORE" ]; then
	if [ "$CONF_RESTORE" != "-" ] && [ ! -f "$CONF_RESTORE" ]; then
		echo "Backup archive '$CONF_RESTORE' not found."
		exit 1
	fi

	[ "$VERBOSE" -gt 1 ] && TAR_V="v" || TAR_V=""
	tar -C / -x${TAR_V}zf "$CONF_RESTORE"
	exit $?
fi

type platform_check_image >/dev/null 2>/dev/null || {
	echo "Firmware upgrade is not implemented for this platform."
	exit 1
}
for check in $sysupgrade_image_check; do
	( eval "$check \"\$ARGV\"" ) || {
		if [ $FORCE -eq 1 ]; then
			echo "Image check '$check' failed but --force given - will update anyway!"
			break
		else
			echo "Image check '$check' failed."
			exit 1
		fi
	}
done

if [ -n "$CONF_IMAGE" ]; then
	case "$(get_magic_word $CONF_IMAGE cat)" in
		# .gz files
		1f8b) ;;
		*)
			echo "Invalid config file. Please use only .tar.gz files"
			exit 1
		;;
	esac
	get_image "$CONF_IMAGE" "cat" > "$CONF_TAR"
	export SAVE_CONFIG=1
elif ask_bool $SAVE_CONFIG "Keep config files over reflash"; then
	[ $TEST -eq 1 ] || do_save_conffiles
	export SAVE_CONFIG=1
else
	export SAVE_CONFIG=0
fi

if [ $TEST -eq 1 ]; then
	exit 0
fi
run_hooks "" $sysupgrade_pre_upgrade

{
	echo $(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n active_part)

do_flash_mtd() {
	local tag=$1
	local image=$2
	local mtdname=$3

	local mtdpart=$(grep "\"${mtdname}\"" /proc/mtd 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '{print $1}')
	/usr/sbin/imageTool -t $tag -i $image -w /dev/$mtdpart &>/dev/null
        if [ $? != 0 ]; then
                echo "imageTool burn image failed!" |tee -a $UPGRADELOG
                exit 1
        fi
}

do_flash_failsafe_partition() {
	local tag=$1
	local image=$2
	local mtdname=$3

	# Fail safe upgrade
	primaryboot=$(get_boot_index)
	if [ $primaryboot -eq 0 ]; then
		mtdname="0:WIFIFW"
	else
		mtdname="0:WIFIFW_1"
	fi

	do_flash_mtd $tag $image $mtdname &>/dev/null
}

{
	local tag=$1

	primaryboot=$(get_boot_index)
	if [ $primaryboot -eq 0 ]; then

	else

	do_flash_mtd $tag $image $mtdname &>/dev/null

platform_pre_upgrade() {
	cp -f /sbin/upgraded /tmp &>/dev/null
	ubus call system nandupgrade "{\"path\": \"$1\" }" &>/dev/null

platform_check_image() {
	echo -e "\n\nSoftware upgrade start @ $(date) ..." |tee -a $UPGRADELOG
	/usr/sbin/imageTool -t imginfo -i $1 -o $IMGUPGINFO &>/dev/null
	if [ $? != 0 ]; then 
		echo "Software image $1 parsing failed!" |tee -a $UPGRADELOG
		rm -rf $1 &>/dev/null
		return 1
	fi

	curImgVersion=$(cat /etc/buildinfo | grep -w IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
	curSWVersion=$(cat /etc/buildinfo | grep -w SOFTWAREVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
	upgImgVersion=$(grep -w IMAGEVERSION $IMGUPGINFO | cut -d'=' -f2)
	upgSWVersion=$(grep -w SOFTWAREVERSION $IMGUPGINFO | cut -d'=' -f2)
	partnumber=$(/usr/sbin/ritool get PartNumber |cut -d: -f2 |sed 's/^[ \t]//g '|cut -c-10)
	grep $partnumber $IMGUPGINFO &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
		echo "Checking image ..." |tee -a $UPGRADELOG
		echo "Software upgrade from $curImgVersion($curSWVersion) to $upgImgVersion($upgSWVersion) ..." |tee -a $UPGRADELOG
		return 0
	else
		echo "Software image NOT match HW version, upgrade forbidden!" |tee -a $UPGRADELOG
		rm -rf $1
		return 1
	fi
}

set_img_ver() {

	# update version after burning image
	curImgVersion=$(cat /etc/buildinfo | grep -w IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
	newImgVersion=$(grep -w IMAGEVERSION $IMGUPGINFO | cut -d'=' -f2)

	current=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n active_part)
	standby=$((1-$current))

	/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$current $curImgVersion &>/dev/null
	/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$standby $newImgVersion &>/dev/null

	# set valid bit
	sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	if [ $standby -eq 0 ]; then
		let "sb_data=sb_num | 0x02"
	else
		let "sb_data=sb_num | 0x20"
	fi
	/usr/sbin/fw_setenv sb_flag $sb_data
}

clear_img_ver() {

	# set imageversion null brfore burning
	# newImgVersion="null"
	current=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n active_part)
	standby=$((1-$current))
	# no need clear passive image version before burn.
	#/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$standby $newImgVersion &>/dev/null

	# clear valid bit
	sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	if [ $standby -eq 0 ]; then
		let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xFD"
	else
		let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xDF"
	fi
	/usr/sbin/fw_setenv sb_flag $sb_data
}

platform_do_upgrade() {
	for tag_list in $(/usr/exe/json_paser PackImageParas.SubImageInfo < /etc/HB_Config.json)
	do
		tag=$(echo $tag_list | cut -d: -f1)
		case "${tag}" in
			boot) do_flash_mtd $tag $1 "ssb" ;;
			part_table) do_flash_mtd $tag $1 "uboot-env" ;;
			rootfs) do_flash_mtd $tag $1 "rootfs$((1-$(get_boot_index)))" ;;
			wifi_fw) do_flash_failsafe_wififw $tag $1 "0:WIFIFW"
		esac
	done
	echo "Software image $1 upgrade completed!" >/dev/console 2>&1 | tee -a $UPGRADELOG
	rm -rf $1 &>/dev/null
}

#!/bin/sh

RAM_ROOT=/tmp/root

[ -x /usr/bin/ldd ] || ldd() { LD_TRACE_LOADED_OBJECTS=1 $*; }
libs() { ldd $* 2>/dev/null | sed -r 's/(.* => )?(.*) .*/\2/'; }

install_file() { # <file> [ <file> ... ]
	for file in "$@"; do
		dest="$RAM_ROOT/$file"
		[ -f $file -a ! -f $dest ] && {
			dir="$(dirname $dest)"
			mkdir -p "$dir"
			cp $file $dest
		}
	done
}

install_bin() { # <file> [ <symlink> ... ]
	src=$1
	files=$1
	[ -x "$src" ] && files="$src $(libs $src)"
	install_file $files
	shift
	for link in "$@"; do {
		dest="$RAM_ROOT/$link"
		dir="$(dirname $dest)"
		mkdir -p "$dir"
		[ -f "$dest" ] || ln -s $src $dest
	}; done
}

supivot() { # <new_root> <old_root>
	/bin/mount | grep "on $1 type" 2>&- 1>&- || /bin/mount -o bind $1 $1
	mkdir -p $1$2 $1/proc $1/sys $1/dev $1/tmp $1/overlay && \
	/bin/mount -o noatime,move /proc $1/proc && \
	pivot_root $1 $1$2 || {
		/bin/umount -l $1 $1
		return 1
	}

	/bin/mount -o noatime,move $2/sys /sys
	/bin/mount -o noatime,move $2/dev /dev
	/bin/mount -o noatime,move $2/tmp /tmp
	/bin/mount -o noatime,move $2/overlay /overlay 2>&-
	return 0
}

run_ramfs() { # <command> [...]
	install_bin /bin/busybox /bin/ash /bin/sh /bin/mount /bin/umount	\
		/sbin/pivot_root /usr/bin/wget /sbin/reboot /bin/sync /bin/dd	\
		/bin/grep /bin/cp /bin/mv /bin/tar /usr/bin/md5sum "/usr/bin/["	\
		/bin/dd /bin/vi /bin/ls /bin/cat /usr/bin/awk /usr/bin/hexdump	\
		/bin/sleep /bin/zcat /usr/bin/bzcat /usr/bin/printf /usr/bin/wc \
		/bin/cut /usr/bin/printf /bin/sync /bin/mkdir /bin/rmdir	\
		/bin/rm /usr/bin/basename /bin/kill /bin/chmod /bin/sed

	install_bin /sbin/mtd
	install_bin /sbin/mount_root
	install_bin /sbin/snapshot
	install_bin /sbin/snapshot_tool
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubiupdatevol
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubiattach
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubiblock
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubiformat
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubidetach
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubirsvol
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubirmvol
	install_bin /usr/sbin/ubimkvol
	for file in $RAMFS_COPY_BIN; do
		install_bin ${file//:/ }
	done
	install_file /etc/resolv.conf /lib/*.sh /lib/functions/*.sh /lib/upgrade/*.sh $RAMFS_COPY_DATA

	[ -L "/lib64" ] && ln -s /lib $RAM_ROOT/lib64

	supivot $RAM_ROOT /mnt || {
		echo "Failed to switch over to ramfs. Please reboot."
		exit 1
	}

	/bin/mount -o remount,ro /mnt
	/bin/umount -l /mnt

	grep /overlay /proc/mounts > /dev/null && {
		/bin/mount -o noatime,remount,ro /overlay
		/bin/umount -l /overlay
	}

	exec /bin/busybox ash -c "$*"
}

kill_remaining() { # [ <signal> ]
	local sig="${1:-TERM}"
	echo -n "Sending $sig to remaining processes ... "

	local my_pid=$$
	local my_ppid=$(cut -d' ' -f4  /proc/$my_pid/stat)
	local my_ppisupgraded=
	grep -q upgraded /proc/$my_ppid/cmdline >/dev/null && {
		local my_ppisupgraded=1
	}
	
	local stat
	for stat in /proc/[0-9]*/stat; do
		[ -f "$stat" ] || continue

		local pid name state ppid rest
		read pid name state ppid rest < $stat
		name="${name#(}"; name="${name%)}"

		local cmdline
		read cmdline < /proc/$pid/cmdline

		# Skip kernel threads
		[ -n "$cmdline" ] || continue

		if [ $$ -eq 1 ] || [ $my_ppid -eq 1 ] && [ -n "$my_ppisupgraded" ]; then
			# Running as init process, kill everything except me
			if [ $pid -ne $$ ] && [ $pid -ne $my_ppid ]; then
				echo -n "$name "
				kill -$sig $pid 2>/dev/null
			fi
		else 
			case "$name" in
				# Skip essential services
				*upgraded*|*procd*|*ash*|*init*|*watchdog*|*ssh*|*dropbear*|*telnet*|*login*|*hostapd*|*wpa_supplicant*|*nas*) : ;;

				# Killable process
				*)
					if [ $pid -ne $$ ] && [ $ppid -ne $$ ]; then
						echo -n "$name "
						kill -$sig $pid 2>/dev/null
					fi
				;;
			esac
		fi
	done
	echo ""
}

run_hooks() {
	local arg="$1"; shift
	for func in "$@"; do
		eval "$func $arg"
	done
}

ask_bool() {
	local default="$1"; shift;
	local answer="$default"

	[ "$INTERACTIVE" -eq 1 ] && {
		case "$default" in
			0) echo -n "$* (y/N): ";;
			*) echo -n "$* (Y/n): ";;
		esac
		read answer
		case "$answer" in
			y*) answer=1;;
			n*) answer=0;;
			*) answer="$default";;
		esac
	}
	[ "$answer" -gt 0 ]
}

v() {
	[ "$VERBOSE" -ge 1 ] && echo "$@"
}

rootfs_type() {
	/bin/mount | awk '($3 ~ /^\/$/) && ($5 !~ /rootfs/) { print $5 }'
}

get_image() { # <source> [ <command> ]
	local from="$1"
	local conc="$2"
	local cmd

	case "$from" in
		http://*|ftp://*) cmd="wget -O- -q";;
		*) cmd="cat";;
	esac
	if [ -z "$conc" ]; then
		local magic="$(eval $cmd \"$from\" 2>/dev/null | dd bs=2 count=1 2>/dev/null | hexdump -n 2 -e '1/1 "%02x"')"
		case "$magic" in
			1f8b) conc="zcat";;
			425a) conc="bzcat";;
		esac
	fi

	eval "$cmd \"$from\" 2>/dev/null ${conc:+| $conc}"
}

get_magic_word() {
	(get_image "$@" | dd bs=2 count=1 | hexdump -v -n 2 -e '1/1 "%02x"') 2>/dev/null
}

get_magic_long() {
	(get_image "$@" | dd bs=4 count=1 | hexdump -v -n 4 -e '1/1 "%02x"') 2>/dev/null
}

jffs2_copy_config() {
	if grep rootfs_data /proc/mtd >/dev/null; then
		# squashfs+jffs2
		mtd -e rootfs_data jffs2write "$CONF_TAR" rootfs_data &>/dev/null
	else
		# jffs2
		mtd jffs2write "$CONF_TAR" rootfs &>/dev/null
	fi
}

# Flash firmware to MTD partition
#
# $(1): path to image
# $(2): (optional) pipe command to extract firmware, e.g. dd bs=n skip=m
default_do_upgrade() {
	sync
	if [ "$SAVE_CONFIG" -eq 1 ]; then
		get_image "$1" "$2" | mtd $MTD_CONFIG_ARGS -j "$CONF_TAR" write - "${PART_NAME:-image}" &>/dev/null
	else
		get_image "$1" "$2" | mtd write - "${PART_NAME:-image}" &>/dev/null
	fi
}

check_backup_volume()
{
	volume_map=$1
	volume_name=$(echo "${volume_map}" |cut -d: -f1)
	volume_id=$(echo "${volume_map}" |cut -d: -f2)
	primaryboot=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n active_part)
	if [ $primaryboot -eq 0 ]; then
		mtd_backup="4"	#/dev/mtd4
	else
		mtd_backup="3"	#/dev/mtd3
	fi
	mkdir -p /tmp/$volume_name
	/usr/sbin/ubiattach /dev/ubi_ctrl -m $mtd_backup -d $mtd_backup &> /dev/null
	if [ $? != 0 ];then
		echo "MSG: ubiattach backup $volume_name failed..." >> $UPGRADELOG
		return 1
	fi
	/usr/sbin/ubiblock -c /dev/ubi${mtd_backup}_${volume_id} &> /dev/null
	if [ $? == 0 ];then
		mdev -s &>/dev/null
		mount -t squashfs /dev/ubiblock${mtd_backup}_${volume_id} /tmp/$volume_name &> /dev/null
		if [ $? != 0 ]; then
			echo "MSG: mount backup $volume_name failed..." >> $UPGRADELOG
			ubiblock -r /dev/ubi${mtd_backup}_${volume_id} &> /dev/null
			/usr/sbin/ubidetach /dev/ubi_ctrl -m $mtd_backup &> /dev/null
			return 1
		fi
		umount -l /tmp/$volume_name
	fi
	ubiblock -r /dev/ubi${mtd_backup}_3 &> /dev/null
	/usr/sbin/ubidetach /dev/ubi_ctrl -m $mtd_backup &> /dev/null
	echo "MSG: check backup $volume_name integrity success..." >> $UPGRADELOG
	return 0
}

check_backup_image()
{
	VOLUME_LIST="rootfs:1 wifi_fw:3"
	for volume_map in ${VOLUME_LIST}; do
		check_backup_volume $volume_map
		if [ $? != 0 ];then
			return 1
		fi
	done
	return 0
}

do_upgrade() {
	echo "Performing system upgrade..." | tee -a $UPGRADELOG

	# clear image version
	clear_img_ver &>/dev/null

	if type 'platform_do_upgrade' >/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
		echo "Flsh partitions start..." >> $UPGRADELOG
		platform_do_upgrade "$ARGV"
		echo "Flsh partitions end..." >> $UPGRADELOG
	else
		default_do_upgrade "$ARGV"
	fi

	if [ "$SAVE_CONFIG" -eq 1 ] && type 'platform_copy_config' >/dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
		echo "Copy config start..." >> $UPGRADELOG
		platform_copy_config
		echo "Copy config end..." >> $UPGRADELOG
	fi

	check_backup_image
	if [ $? != 0 ];then
		echo "MSG: check backup image failed..." >> $UPGRADELOG
		echo "MSG: burn image NOK" | tee -a $UPGRADELOG
		return 1
	fi

	set_img_ver &>/dev/null
	echo "MSG: Upgrade completed" | tee -a $UPGRADELOG
	return 0

	[ -n "$DELAY" ] && sleep "$DELAY"
	ask_bool 1 "Reboot" && {
		v "Rebooting system..."
		sleep 2
		reboot -f
		sleep 5
		echo b 2>/dev/null >/proc/sysrq-trigger
	}
}

ethernet_init()

    mac0=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f2 | cut -d" " -f2)
    newMac0=$(( (0x${mac0} + 6) % 256 ))

    enetNum=$(hcfgtool get ENET.NUMS)
    for i in $(seq 1 $enetNum)
    do
        mac1=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f3)
        mac2=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f4)
        mac3=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f5)
        mac4=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f6)
        mac5=$(ritool get MACAddress | cut -d: -f7)

        newMac5=$(( (0x${mac5} + $i) % 256 ))
        carry=$(( (0x${mac5} + $i) / 256 ))

        newMac4=$(( (0x${mac4} + $carry) % 256 ))
        carry=$(( (0x${mac4} + $carry) / 256 ))

        newMac3=$(( (0x${mac3} + $carry) % 256 ))
        carry=$(( (0x${mac3} + $carry) / 256 ))

        newMac2=$(( (0x${mac2} + $carry) % 256 ))
        carry=$(( (0x${mac2} + $carry) / 256 ))

        newMac1=$(( (0x${mac1} + $carry) % 256 ))
        carry=$(( (0x${mac1} + $carry) / 256 ))

        if [ $carry != 0 ]; then
            logger "New mac error basing on MAC:$(ritool get MACAddress)"
        fi

        index=$(($i - 1))
        newMac=$(printf "%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X" $newMac0 $newMac1 $newMac2 $newMac3 $newMac4 $newMac5)
        ifconfig eth$index down
        ifconfig eth$index hw ether $newMac

    done
}

	echo "MSG: set phy led register" > /dev/console 2>&1

	let "polar_val=polar_data & POLAR_SET"
	/usr/sbin/phytool rw 4 $POLAR_ADD $polar_val &>/dev/null

#!/bin/sh
#set -x
# Define a function to check if the interface is in the bridging interface
check_interfaces() {
    # get the bridging interface name
    bridge_interfaces=$(brctl show | awk 'NR > 1 {print $1}')

    #Run "ifconfig - a" to search for all network interface names and filter out interfaces with IP addresses configured, 
    #excluding the lo interface.
    /sbin/ifconfig | awk '
    /^[a-zA-Z0-9]/ {
        iface = $1
    }
    /inet / {
        ip = $2
        if (iface != "lo") {
            print iface, ip
        }
    }' | while read -r iface ip; do
        # check whether if the bridge exist
        if echo "$bridge_interfaces" | grep -qw "$iface"; then
            echo "$iface"
	    break
        else
            echo "9999"
        fi
    done > /tmp/binterface
}

# try time counter
attempts=0

# try 3 times
while [ $attempts -lt 3 ]; do
    
    check_interfaces
    sleep 3

    # check if /tmp/binterface content is "9999"
    if [ "$(cat /tmp/binterface)" = "9999" ]; then
        # try time add one
        attempts=$((attempts + 1))
    else
        break
    fi
done

#!/bin/bash
#
#  Copyright (c) 2018 Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
#
# All Rights Reserved.
# Confidential and Proprietary - Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
#
. /lib/functions.sh

# exit when any command fails
# stops the execution if a command has an error
# set -e

device="$(cat /tmp/sysinfo/model)"
fwpath="$1"
tmpdir="$(mktemp -d)"
tmpfile="$(mktemp)"
img="$2"

part_name="0:WIFIFW"
status="failed"
ubi_part_name="rootfs"

# if a subdevice is specified, eg. qcn9000
if [ "$#" -eq 3 ]; then
	subdev="$3"
fi

if echo "$device" | grep -q "IPQ807" ; then
	flashfw=/lib/firmware/IPQ8074/WIFI_FW
	emmc_part=$(find_mmc_part $part_name 2> /dev/null)
	nand_part=$(find_mtd_part $part_name 2> /dev/null)
elif  echo "$device" | grep -q "IPQ6018" ; then
	flashfw=/lib/firmware/IPQ6018/WIFI_FW
	nand_part=$(find_mtd_part $ubi_part_name 2> /dev/null)
	if [ -z "$nand_part" ]; then
		emmc_part=$(find_mmc_part $part_name 2> /dev/null)
	else
		part_name=ubi_part_name
	fi
elif  echo "$device" | grep -q "IPQ5018" ; then
	flashfw=/lib/firmware/IPQ5018/WIFI_FW
	wififw_part=$(cat /proc/mtd | grep $part_name)
	mtd_dev=$(echo $wififw_part | awk '{print $1}' | sed 's/:$//')
	nor_flash=`find /sys/bus/spi/devices/*/mtd -name ${mtd_dev}`
	nand_part=$(find_mtd_part $ubi_part_name 2> /dev/null)
	if [ -z "$nand_part" ]; then
		emmc_part=$(find_mmc_part $part_name 2> /dev/null)
	else
		part_name=ubi_part_name
	fi
else
	echo "Unrecognized Device...\nCurrently Devices Supported: ipq807x & ipq6018 & ipq5018\n"
	exit 0;
fi

if [ -z "$fwpath" ]; then
	echo "Error:Firmware path is empty\n"
	echo "Usages:Please run as below command:\n"
	echo "wlanfw-upgrade.sh <path_to_fw_files> <fw_type(q6/m3/all)> <sub-device>\n"
	exit 0;
fi

printf " Copying firmware files to $tmpdir..\n"
cp -r $flashfw/* $tmpdir/

if [ "$subdev" == "qcn9000" ]; then
	if [ "$img" == "q6" ]; then
		printf " Copying $subdev Q6 images from $fwpath..\n"
		rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/amss.bin
		cp -r $fwpath/amss.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
	elif [ "$img" == "m3" ]; then
		printf " Copying $subdev M3 images from $fwpath..\n"
		rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/m3.bin
		cp -r $fwpath/m3.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
	else
		printf " Copying $subdev Q6 & M3 images from $fwpath..\n"
		rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/amss.bin
		rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/m3.bin
		cp -r $fwpath/amss.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
		cp -r $fwpath/m3.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
	fi
elif [ "$subdev" == "qcn6122" ]; then
	printf " Copying $subdev M3 images from $fwpath..\n"
	rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/m3_*
	cp -r $fwpath/m3_* $tmpdir/$subdev/
elif [ "$img" == "q6" ]; then
	printf " Copying Q6 fw files from $fwpath..\n"
	rm -rf $tmpdir/q6_*
	cp -r $fwpath/q6_* $tmpdir/
elif [ "$img" == "m3" ]; then
	printf " Copying M3 fw files from $fwpath..\n"
	rm -rf $tmpdir/m3_*
	cp -r $fwpath/m3_* $tmpdir/
else
	printf " Copying Q6 & M3 fw files from $fwpath..\n"
	rm -rf $tmpdir/q6_*
	rm -rf $tmpdir/m3_*
	cp -r $fwpath/q6_* $tmpdir/
	cp -r $fwpath/m3_* $tmpdir/

	subdev="qcn9000"
	if [ -d "$flashfw/$subdev" ]; then
		printf " Copying $subdev Q6 & M3 images from $fwpath..\n"
		if [ -f "$fwpath/amss.bin" ]; then
			rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/amss.bin
			cp -r $fwpath/amss.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
		fi

		if [ -f "$fwpath/m3.bin" ]; then
			rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/m3.bin
			cp -r $fwpath/m3.bin $tmpdir/$subdev/
		fi
	fi

	subdev="qcn6122"
	if [[ -d "$flashfw/$subdev" && -d "$tmpdir/$subdev" ]]; then
		printf " Copying $subdev M3 images from $fwpath/$subdev..\n"
		rm -rf $tmpdir/$subdev/m3_*
		cp -r $fwpath/$subdev/m3_* $tmpdir/$subdev/
	fi
fi

printf " Preparing squashfs image..\n"
mksquashfs4  $tmpdir/  $tmpfile -nopad -noappend -root-owned -comp xz -Xpreset 9 -Xe -Xlc 0 -Xlp 2 -Xpb 2 -Xbcj arm -b 256k -processors 1

if [ -n "$emmc_part" ]; then
	emmc_blk=$( echo $emmc_part | cut -c 6-15)
	emmc_partsize=$( cat /sys/class/block/$emmc_blk/size )

	printf " Unmounting $emmc_part \n"
	umount $emmc_part || true

	printf " Flashing squashfs image on $emmc_part ..\n"
	dd if=/dev/zero of=$emmc_part bs=512 count=$emmc_partsize
	dd if=$tmpfile of=$emmc_part

	printf " Mounting $emmc_part \n"
	/bin/mount -t squashfs $emmc_part $flashfw
	status="completed"
elif [ -n "$nor_flash" ]; then
	printf " Unmounting $$mtd_dev \n"
	umount $flashfw || true
	mtd -e /dev/$mtd_dev write $tmpfile /dev/$mtd_dev
	/bin/mount -t squashfs /dev/${mtd_dev//mtd/mtdblock} $flashfw
	status="completed"
elif [ -n "$nand_part" ]; then
	mtdpart=$(grep "\"$part_name\"" /proc/mtd | awk -F: '{print $1}')

	size=$(ls -s $tmpfile | awk '{print $1 "KiB"}')

	printf " Unmounting $flashfw \n"
	umount $flashfw || true

	if [ "$part_name" == "0:WIFIFW" ]; then
		printf " Flash squashfs image on $nand_part\n"
		ubidetach -f -p /dev/$mtdpart || true
		sync

		printf " Formatting /dev/$mtdpart \n"
		ubiformat /dev/$mtdpart

		printf " Attaching ubi on /dev/$mtdpart \n"
		ubiattach -p /dev/${mtdpart}
		ubimkvol /dev/ubi1 -N wifi_fw -s $size
		ubiupdatevol /dev/ubi1_0 $tmpfile
	else
		printf " Flash squashfs image on wifi_fw vol in rootfs partition\n"
		ubirmvol /dev/ubi0 -N wifi_fw
		ubimkvol /dev/ubi0 -N wifi_fw -s $size
		ubiupdatevol /dev/ubi0_1 $tmpfile
	fi

	ubi_part=$(find_mtd_part wifi_fw 2> /dev/null)

	printf " Mounting $ubi_part\n"
	/bin/mount -t squashfs $ubi_part $flashfw
	status="completed"
else
	printf " Flash Type Not Supported \n"
fi

printf " Cleaning up temp files..\n"
rm -rf  $tmpfile $tmpdir/
printf " wlan fw upgrade $status !\n"
